# did:dht test vectors

The official test vectors of the did:dht method specification (<https://did-dht.com/#test-vectors>), in the machine-readable
form its reference implementation tests against:
<https://github.com/decentralized-identity/did-dht/tree/3fa953603a80ae269a1f83e4f75ff86082bcd30b/impl/internal/did/testdata>.

Copied unchanged from commit `3fa953603a80ae269a1f83e4f75ff86082bcd30b` of decentralized-identity/did-dht (Apache-2.0).
Vector 2 uses vector 1's identity key (`vector-1-public-key-jwk-1.json`), as the specification does.
